judgment_calls.decision: Keep API hosting with execution rather than cockpit.
judgment_calls.alternative: Home server.py under the interface surface.
judgment_calls.reason: Its trust, lease, and workflow command boundary dominates its static-hosting role.

semi_lattice_signals.reason: The composition root legitimately connects API authority, workflows, and UI hosting while retaining one primary home.

claims.summary: Loom persists an append-only invocation lattice with content-addressed context and independently reconstructable sealed manifests.
Claude and Codex execution is leased, journaled, restart-aware, and terminalized, while complete runtime influence and artifact inspection remain incomplete.
Octopus import, governed context modules, workflow bootstrap, and quaternary state inspection exist; the German workflow remains calibrating rather than closed.
The response-first cockpit operates manual multi-parent routing and preflight, but its exact-context presentation remains incomplete.
Truth-typed automated tests and clean build metadata exist; the independent whole-system audit is not part of the frozen source baseline.
